campaign_brief.objective: Position the Shockwave V1 Pro as the dependable, comfortable, and portable electric kick scooter for urban and campus commutes on real Indian streets.
campaign_brief.key_message: The Shockwave V1 Pro offers a dependable, comfortable, and foldable ride, built to navigate India's urban landscape with ease, making daily commutes genuinely fun.

proof_points.claim: Dual suspension system handles bumpy roads, ensuring a smooth and stable ride.
Foldable 6061 aluminum alloy frame supports up to 120 kg for easy storage and transport.
Offers up to 30 km range on a single charge, minimizing the need for frequent recharging for daily commutes.
Puncture-proof 8.5-inch solid tires provide better grip and smooth handling across city roads and varied terrain.

campaign_brief.success_metric: Increase in product page views and add-to-cart rates for Shockwave V1 Pro.

script.title: Shockwave V1 Pro: Built for Indian Streets

beats.line: Bumpy roads, crowded lanes. Getting around is tough.
Meet the Shockwave V1 Pro. From Radboards.
Dual suspension handles rough roads. Puncture-proof tires grip. Go up to 30 km on one charge. (Range varies.) Folds fast, carries easily. Supports 120 kg. LED lights. Dual brakes for quick stops.
beats.on_screen: DUAL SUSPENSION. 30 KM RANGE. FOLDS FAST. 120 KG CAPACITY. LED LIGHTS. DUAL BRAKES.

beats.line: Ready for a smoother ride? Visit Radboards.in.

caption: Navigate city streets and campus corridors with the Shockwave V1 Pro. Built for real Indian roads, its dual suspension smooths out bumps. Puncture-proof 8.5-inch tires mean no surprises. Go up to 30 km on a charge, then fold it up. Holds 120 kg. Perfect for commutes or campus. (Range varies with rider weight.) Ready for a smoother ride? Link in bio. 👇
